item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubaḓi jan-a miḓ-ra ṱan-a sila kiged, yeke / nayiraγuluγči kelemürči banḓi yêsesdi orčiγuluγad, nayiraγulǰu sine ǰasaγlaγsan ayalγus-iyar ǰasaǰu / orosiγulbai, mongγol-un kelen-tür ananḓa güsi včir qoyar orčiγulbai. , .
